tweets.text:
Grocery run? 

On Thursday, San Diego Border Patrol agents seized a significant amount of narcotics. Hidden in grocery bags and cardboard boxes, agents found 65lbs of meth and 2lbs of fentanyl. Thanks to one of our trusty K9's and the hard work of our BP agents, these groceries will not be delivered.

HUGE SEIZURE!

Along with the help of @ICEGov, CBP officers in Detroit seized 1,047lbs of cocaine and 937lbs of meth. The shipments were found within tractor trucks.  

The Detroit Field Office has seized more than 4,300 pounds of cocaine and nearly 1,000 pounds of meth during Fiscal Year 2025 thus far. Learn more about CBP’s drug interdiction efforts.
